column2: The Self-Blamer Let Off The Hook
column6: This is what's actually causing it moves the fault from her face onto an object she can replace.
Sniff Big Sur everywhere sells a place rather than a scent; the name is what gets repeated at a party.
Leather sandalwood amber set like a fragrance note list; the house is being treated as something worn.
Black, gold and constellations; the diffuser is being positioned as furniture with a price to match.
A bright kitchen and a bottle held mid-explanation; the woman is the format, the scent is the subject.
Rippling water standing in for a smell; the abstraction is the only way to render the product.
The monogram is the entire message; no copy is needed because the pattern is the copy.
Slides on printed silk; the styling is doing the pricing and the logo is doing the arguing.
A body in the sea with the hardware just visible; the aspiration is the location as much as the object.
A bag on an old chair in an empty room; heritage staging is what separates this from a logo tote.
Horsebit hardware on black; the shape is recognisable at a distance, which is the function.
Softer than your fave tee benchmarks against something she owns; softness cannot be shown any other way.
HSA/FSA eligible turns bedding into a medical expense; the tax code is the discount.
Without the electricity bill prices the alternative; she is already running the air conditioning and resenting it.
A Good Housekeeping review laid out as an article; the format is borrowed so the verdict is too.
Back in stock assumes she tried to buy it once; the colour name is the only other information given.
Just arrived and SOFTER in the same frame; the comparative has no referent and does not need one.
Best bedding for pet lovers accepts the dog is on the bed; the constraint is being validated, not solved.
Turkish and spa-inspired in one line; she is buying a version of a morning, not a towel.
